exitCodes.name: SUCCESS
exitCodes.meaning: Requested operation completed and emitted no error diagnostics.

exitCodes.name: USAGE_ERROR
exitCodes.meaning: Unknown option/command, malformed argument, conflicting mode, or missing required argument.

exitCodes.name: COMPILATION_ERROR
exitCodes.meaning: Input was understood but Javelle/frontend/javac reported an error diagnostic.

exitCodes.name: TOOLCHAIN_OR_IO_ERROR
exitCodes.meaning: Required JDK/tool/file/model is missing, inaccessible, invalid, or output publication failed.

exitCodes.name: INTERNAL_ERROR
exitCodes.meaning: Unexpected compiler defect after bounded sanitization; no stack trace is written to machine stdout.

exitCodes.name: NOT_AVAILABLE
exitCodes.meaning: Recognized command or feature is intentionally unavailable in this installed version/stage.

exitCodes.name: TIMEOUT
exitCodes.meaning: Configured operation deadline expired and no partial outputs were published.

exitCodes.name: INTERRUPTED
exitCodes.meaning: SIGINT/Ctrl-C cancellation completed and no partial outputs were published.
